body_text:
Dear students,

Happy New Year! We will be commencing our first lesson next week. Before
that, I like to bring your attention to the following matters.

*INTRODUCTION*
To my new class, S1-04, I will be your Math/Form Teacher. In any case,
*WELCOME*!

*GOOGLE CLASSROOM & ICT LESSONS*
This year, we will try our best to use Google Classroom more than usual.
And as I have promised, we will integrate more lessons involving ICT and
activities, provided that I have *FULL COOPERATION* from the respective
classes. My belief holds - to create engaging and meaningful lessons.

*PREPARATION FOR FIRST LESSON*
Please bring along writing materials and calculator for first lesson. A
diagnostic test will be conducted and if you need to clarify anything,
please feel free to email me privately. And yes, if your question pertains
to getting solutions from me, you have struck jackpot! Because I will only
provide you with the solutions.... *AFTER*.

*BOOKMARKS*
It will be good for you to bookmark the following links so that we do not
have to scamper around for this year.

   - GoogleSite (Mathematics) : LINK
   <https://sites.google.com/a/s2018.ssts.edu.sg/math/>
   - Desmos : LINK <https://www.desmos.com/>
   - Google Classroom : LINK <https://classroom.google.com/h> *(Your first
   assignment of the year has been posted and it is due on 7 January 2019)*
   - Kahoot! : LINK <https://kahoot.it/>
   - Khan Academy : LINK <https://www.khanacademy.org/>

And more to come!

Thank you!


*Peh Pei Hsin Desmond 白培新*
Academic Staff, Mathematics Department
Teacher In-Charge, Fencing
